metadata.difficultyPolicy: Each subcategory has 100 exercises per grade. Difficulty stars are mixed inside each grade: 34 one-star, 33 two-star, 33 three-star exercises. Grade complexity increases strongly from grade 1 to grade 6.
metadata.gradeProgressionPolicy: Grade 1 uses recognition, counting, short words, concrete shapes and very small numbers. Grade 6 uses multi-step arithmetic, larger values, percentages, fractions, grammar concepts, abstract reasoning and more advanced world knowledge.
metadata.answerPolicy: Every answer option display value and value must be unique inside the exercise. Shape answers use symbols, not shape names.
metadata.generatedPuzzlePolicy: Do not include sudoku or math_crossword here; those are generated in-app.
metadata.answerDisplayLocalizationPolicy: Answer options include <display locale="nl-BE|en-US|fr-BE">. Use canonical answer/@value for correctness and locale display for UI.
metadata.title: Taal
Language
Langue
metadata.audioPolicy: Audio exercises use <audioSources>. The app must show only the play button when visibleText=false. Use audio/@text for TTS and audio/@ttsLanguage for pronunciation. Audio text is human-readable and must not contain underscores.
metadata.categoryPolicy: World knowledge and geometry are separate main categories in v3.5. Translation is split into translation_to_english and translation_to_french.
metadata.diversityPolicy: v3.5 increases vocabulary variety and reduces repeated early arithmetic prompts such as 0 + 2 by using wider number pools, story variants, and deterministic anti-repeat generation.
